description: Every Backup Radar v3 and v2 endpoint plus a local store that finds the backups nobody is watching.

auth_env_var_specs.name: BACKUP_RADAR_API_KEY
auth_env_var_specs.description: ScalePad API key for the v3 commands (health, devices, backups ingest, backups retire, push). Create one in ScalePad: API tab, New API key. https://developer.scalepad.com/docs/getting-started

auth_env_var_specs.name: BACKUP_RADAR_V2_API_KEY
auth_env_var_specs.description: Backup Radar API key for the v2 commands (backups list, get, results, filters, inactive, retired, overview). Set it if you use the read-only Backup Radar API v2.

novel_features.name: Morning backup check
novel_features.description: One ranked list of today's failing, silent and at-risk backups, each marked new or ongoing with days in status and open ticket count; uses whichever keys you synced.

novel_features.name: Who is nobody watching
novel_features.description: Every backup Backup Radar receives but nobody acts on: inactive, unmapped to ScalePad, failing with no ticket, no PSA company, or warnings counted as success by policy. Unmapped needs the v3 key; the other reasons need the v2 key.

novel_features.name: Cross-vendor coverage diff
novel_features.description: Compare the devices a backup vendor protects against what Backup Radar monitors and list the gaps in both directions.

novel_features.name: Retire candidates
novel_features.description: Backups with no result in N days, grouped by client, with retire request bodies ready to preview; works from either key's synced data.

novel_features.name: Client compliance scorecard
novel_features.description: In-compliance rate, weekly trend and worst devices for one client, or every client ranked, from up to a year of client health (v3 key); worst devices use synced device history (each sync fetches 90 days; stored days accumulate up to a year).

novel_features.name: Device timeline
novel_features.description: One device's day-by-day backup story merged from both API generations, with tickets, tags and notes; --live adds each day's v2 results (v2 key).

novel_features.name: Validated bulk ingest
novel_features.description: Push flat CSV or JSONL backup results into Backup Radar (v3 key, live write) with local validation and automatic batching under the 10,000-result limit.
